entry.title: New: Bill 127 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 25, ARTICLE 2, DIVISION 4, SECTION 25-2-44, OF (Draft 2) THE HAWAIʻI COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO CONDITIONS ON CHANGE OF ZONE

Requires the Planning Director to include time constraints for the completion or satisfaction of conditions imposed in change of zoning district ordinances that do not revert zoning to a previous zoning district designation or an open zoning designation.

Latest action: Council: Bill 127, Draft 4 passes second & final reading - 9/17/2024
